exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.name: SEALED_PAYLOAD_SINGLE_BYTE_TAMPER
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.setup: Copy EntityOS, change one byte inside the embedded sealed payload in ELF rodata, preserve executable headers/code, then run --selfcheck; retain original as rollback/baseline.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.prediction_if_seal_is_effective: Tampered copy remains loadable but selfcheck rejects it; original remains green.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.observed: tampered copy rc=41 with ENTITYOS_SELF_SEAL_FAIL; original immediately rechecked ENTITYOS_SELF_SEAL_OK
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: original artifact never modified; tampered copy deleted

external_primary_source_fusion.gcc_static_linking: Current GCC documentation states -static prevents linking with shared libraries on systems supporting dynamic linking.
external_primary_source_fusion.linux_proc_exe: Linux proc_pid_exe documentation confirms the executed file can be reopened via /proc/pid/exe; useful future basis for stronger whole-file self-attestation.
external_primary_source_fusion.architecture_consequence: Keep the release as one ELF; next attestation iteration should bind the whole executable rather than only a sealed payload region.
